name: mac-ui-worker
description: Route bounded UI-only work from a Codex Desktop source task, especially a remote GCP-backed task, to one Mac-local Codex Desktop worker bound to that exact source task. Use when a job needs the Mac task-scoped in-app Browser, native Computer Use, existing Mac UI or login state, direct collaboration with the user for login, MFA, credential entry, clarification, or fresh approval, or a declared source-owned dependency. Also use inside a Mac worker that receives protocol mac-ui-worker/v1. Do not use when a connector, API, or CLI fully handles the task, or when native Desktop transport is unavailable.
